verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms React publishes a structured llms.txt at react.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200, a 'React Documentation' index starting with Learn React sections). The cited docs pages are also served as raw .md URLs (e.g., /learn.md, /reference/react-dom/client/createRoot.md), which suits agent consumption. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs usage, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it, and evidence of a full-content variant (e.g., llms-full.txt).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
